# Forensics Colleges

> A comprehensive guide to forensic science degree programs, specializations, and career paths at accredited colleges and universities nationwide.

Forensics Colleges provides detailed information about undergraduate and graduate forensic science programs, including specialized tracks in DNA analysis, crime scene investigation, computer forensics, and forensic psychology. The site features career outlooks, salary information, and expert insights to help students choose the right forensic education path.

## Key Topics

- Forensic Science Degrees
- DNA Analysis
- Crime Scene Investigation
- Computer Forensics
- Forensic Chemistry
- Forensic Biology
- Criminal Justice
- Forensic Pathology
- Forensic Psychology
- Forensic Accounting
- Online Education
- Career Paths
- Accredited Programs
- FEPAC Accreditation
- Certifications

## Core Forensic Science Programs

- [Top Forensic Science Colleges & Universities](https://www.forensicscolleges.com): Homepage directing users to forensic science degree programs and career paths.
- [Forensic Science Programs - Colleges with Forensics Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs): Main directory comparing forensic science degree programs and specializations.
- [Forensic Science Degree Programs - Undergraduate & Graduate Level](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-science): Guide to forensic science degrees with career opportunities and expert insights.
- [Crime Scene Investigator Colleges - CSI Degree Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/crime-scene-investigation): Crime scene investigation degree and certificate programs with expert guidance.
- [Computer Forensics Colleges - Digital Forensic Science Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/computer-forensics): Computer forensics programs for cybercrime and digital fraud investigation.

## Specialized Forensic Tracks

- [DNA Analyst Education - Forensic DNA Analysis Degree Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/dna-analyst): DNA analyst specialization programs with career path and educational requirements.
- [Forensic Biology Programs, Career Outlook & Pay](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-biology): Forensic biology programs with career outlook and salary information.
- [Accredited Forensic Chemistry Programs - Coursework & Certifications](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-chemistry): Forensic chemistry degree programs with FEPAC accreditation and certifications.
- [Online Forensic Toxicology Degree & Certificate Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-toxicology): Forensic toxicology degrees and certificates with expert interviews.
- [Forensic Medicine Programs - Online & On-Campus](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-medicine): Forensic medicine and pathology degree programs available online and on-campus.
- [Colleges with Forensic Science Technician Programs - Lab Tech](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-technician): Forensic technician programs including certificates, degrees, and certifications.

## Investigation & Analysis Programs

- [Crime & Intelligence Analysis Programs - Degrees & Certification](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/crime-intelligence-analysis): Crime and intelligence analysis degree programs with professor interview.
- [Criminal Profiler Education - Profiler Degree Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/criminal-profiler): Criminal profiler degree programs with FBI Behavioral Analysis Unit insights.
- [Forensic Accounting Degree Programs - Fraud & Financial Crime](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-accounting): Forensic accounting programs teaching fraud detection and financial analysis.
- [Forensic Psychology Colleges with Online Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-psychology): Forensic psychology online programs at criminal justice and APA-accredited schools.

## Medical & Pathology Programs

- [Forensic Pathology Schools & Colleges - Become a Pathologist](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/forensic-pathology): Forensic pathology and medical examiner degree programs with certifications.
- [Schools with Forensic Pathologists' Assistant Programs](https://www.forensicscolleges.com/programs/pathologist-assistant): Pathologist assistant programs with autopsy and clinical laboratory training.
